description: Review a proposed design, plan, RFC, or architecture before or during implementation for requirements fit, simpler alternatives, trade-offs, failure modes, operability, and rollout risk, and report a recommendation with concrete concerns. Use when the user asks to review, critique, or sanity-check a design, plan, technical proposal, RFC, or architecture decision, or asks whether an approach is sound. Do not use for reviewing a code diff (use agent-kit:code-review), for security-specific analysis (use agent-kit:threat-model), or for implementing the design (use agent-kit:feature-implementation); this skill reports and does not edit code.
